rows.content: The scales were recalibrated at dawn. Ammit is fed and resting.
Charon has raised the fare. Bring two obols.
Limbo book club on Thursday as usual; Virgil is bringing the Aeneid again.
Cerberus had all three breakfasts. Approach calmly.
Judge Cui's vermilion brush has snapped again, the third this month.
The queue for the First Court reaches the gate. Quiet, please.
Lethe is high this week; do not drink before your paperwork.
Meng Po has a new recipe. Less coptis, she says.
Minos asks everyone to stop counting his tail.
The water is rising under Naihe Bridge. Ferrymen, take care.
Forty-two assessors on shift; bring your negative confessions in order.
Sisyphus reports slight progress. It will not last.
On duty at the First Court today. No one dares look up at the Mirror of Retribution.
The ice in the Ninth Circle is thick this season.
Boat of Ra departs at the twelfth hour sharp.
The terraces of Purgatory have just been whitewashed. Mind the wet plaster.

b.content: The scales were recalibrated at dawn. Ammit is fed and resting.
Charon has raised the fare. Bring two obols.
Limbo book club on Thursday as usual; Virgil is bringing the Aeneid again.
Cerberus had all three breakfasts. Approach calmly.
Judge Cui's vermilion brush has snapped again, the third this month.
The queue for the First Court reaches the gate. Quiet, please.
Lethe is high this week; do not drink before your paperwork.
Meng Po has a new recipe. Less coptis, she says.
Minos asks everyone to stop counting his tail.
The water is rising under Naihe Bridge. Ferrymen, take care.
Forty-two assessors on shift; bring your negative confessions in order.
Sisyphus reports slight progress. It will not last.
On duty at the First Court today. No one dares look up at the Mirror of Retribution.
The ice in the Ninth Circle is thick this season.
Boat of Ra departs at the twelfth hour sharp.
The terraces of Purgatory have just been whitewashed. Mind the wet plaster.
